items.title: Eddie Locke interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, NY, January 13, 2001
items.q: Remember the movie “Apache” with Burt Lancaster?

ctx.x: There was no arrangement. There was nobody that wrote no — a couple of things, in the album “Wrap Tight” there are arrangements. But other than that, the one I love the most is called “Today and Now” with the love song from “Apache” the movie. Remember the movie “Apache” with Burt Lancaster?
